### Into God’s Presence
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-january-6-2022.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 34:7
Points:
- Aging often brings physical limitations, but Moses refused to disengage spiritually in his final years.
- At 120 years old, Moses obeyed God by ascending Mount Nebo to view the Promised Land.
- God showed Moses the land not to discourage him, but to prove His absolute faithfulness to His promises.
- Moses approached the end of his life without fear because he had finished his earthly race well.
- Believers need not fear death, since dying in Christ means entering directly into God's presence.

### Looking into the Promised Land
Author: Sean Michael Lucas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/looking-promised-land
Passage: Deuteronomy 34:1-12
Points:
- God showed mercy to Moses by taking him up to Pisgah to survey the Promised Land before his death.
- Standing on the mountain represented believing God's promises while seeing them only from a distance.
- Although Moses did not enter earthly Canaan, his faithful life of hope was never in vain.
- Moses ultimately entered the true Promised Land when he met the Lord face to face upon his death.
- Believers walk as pilgrims whose longing for eternal rest is made secure in Jesus Christ.
